scripts/start-smto-site.sh

Shell · Tier B

Launch only the public website using its own configuration and port.

Usage

./scripts/start-smto-site.sh [--host HOST] [--port PORT] [--reload]

Inputs

SMTO_SITE_PYTHON or repository .venv; SMTO_SITE_* settings.

Side effects

exec replaces this launcher with one website Uvicorn process.

Cleanup

Signals belong to that process; no other service is started or stopped.

@see src/smto_site/cli.py
